mechanism: Methimazole reduces thyroid hormone production, potentially decreasing propranolol metabolism and increasing its effects; propranolol may mask hyperthyroidism symptoms and reduce methimazole efficacy by decreasing sympathetic manifestations.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and thyroid function regularly; adjust propranolol dose as thyroid function normalizes with methimazole therapy; use propranolol cautiously as it masks hyperthyroidism symptoms.
